description: List what is inside one place of a JSON file, like ls. First line: the type and length of that place (e.g. "object, 4 keys", "array, 12 items"). Then one line per key or index, ready to append to the path. long: true adds TYPE and SIZE columns (like ls -l). Long lists end with "[more] ... next: offset N". Example: {"path": "cfg.json#/states", "long": true}. Details: knowledge_read aos/tools/json_ls.json.

path.description: FILE#/POINTER in one string, e.g. cfg.json#/states/think/next; FILE alone (or FILE#/) = the whole document. Relative files start at your workspace.

long.description: true = also print each child's type and size

offset.description: start at this child (for the next page)

limit.description: at most this many children (default: env AOS_JSON_MAX_ITEMS, else 200)
